text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now then, this month's special will cover<n>the
Senior Spring Double Crown—the<n>spring Tenno
Sho and Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
With one being 3,200 meters and the<n>other
2,200, they obviously call for<n>different
strategies, which I hope to<n>learn more about
through interviews...

text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк
text_block_list.text:
What's different between the spring<n>Tenno Sho
and the Takarazuka Kinen?<n>What do you think,
Инари Ван?

text_block_list.name: Инари Ван
text_block_list.text:
Don't be a goof! There is no difference!<n>At the
end of the day, both races are...

text_block_list.name: Inari & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: A spring festival!

text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк
text_block_list.text: I mean, what else could they be?

text_block_list.name: Инари Ван
text_block_list.text:
Right?! All that matters is winning and<n>making the
crowd go wild!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho and Takarazuka<n>Kinen...
Well, from my perspective, they<n>are the same.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of the distance, my winning<n>equation
will bring me to victory.

text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
text_block_list.text: I couldn't agree more.

text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
text_block_list.text: No matter the distance, it is I who takesthe turf! I who emerges triumphant! Iwho suffers defeat! I am the commondenominator!

text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
text_block_list.text:
The season of spring speaks to my<n>character. Of
course that goes for<n>summer, fall, and winter too!
Haaah ha<n>ha!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I'm quite surprised to see that our<n>opinions
align.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't find a runner who saw a<n>difference. Is
winning both races only<n>possible by not worrying
about things as<n>major as distance?)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: (There must be someone who sees them differently...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They're different if ya ask me.<n>Completely
different. The difference is<n>clear as day.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(Finally! I knew there'd be someone who<n>sees the
difference!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen's at Hanshin,<n>which is
basically Osaka! And the spring<n>Tenno Sho's in
Kyoto! They're nothing<n>alike!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
First of all, the food's way too expensive<n>in
Kyoto. I can't afford to eat anything<n>over there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Basically, the Takarazuka Kinen's home,<n>and the
spring Tenno Sho's away! Got it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I've made a wonderful discovery! The<n>two races
differ not just in length, but<n>also in their image
and culture as well!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I must dig deeper into this perspective...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Time for a food trip around Kyoto and<n>Osaka!
